name: Default
shortDescription: Open source SIEM and XDR platform: the Wazuh manager, indexer and dashboard as a single-node stack with internal TLS and persistent data.

alerts.message: Log in to the dashboard as admin with the generated INDEXER_PASSWORD. The passwords are stored on the first start, so do not change the generated password variables afterwards; follow the upstream password procedure instead.
Agents connect to the wazuh-manager service on TCP 1514 (events) and 1515 (enrollment), which are not routed through the web domain. Publish those ports on the server before enrolling agents.
The stack needs at least 4 GB of RAM, and upstream recommends vm.max_map_count=262144 on the host for the indexer.
